title: Corn Dog Tacos
description: If you never had a corn dog taco, Taco Tuesday's about to change forever.
steps: Add taco seasoning and break up the meat as it cooks.
Once fully cooked, turn off the heat and stir to cool down slightly.
Fold in the Mexican mozzarella, do not stir a lot.
Lay the mixture out on parchment paper to cool down.
Once cooled, form the mixture around kebab sticks.
Make the batter: mix 1 egg, 1 cup Bisquick, 1 cup masa, 1 teaspoon southern seasoning, 2 tablespoons melted butter, and 1 cup milk.
Pour the batter into a tall glass.
Dip the frozen taco on a stick into the batter.
Place in an air fryer set to 350 degrees.
Cook for three to four minutes until golden brown.
